question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

The young one of a cow
solution: The correct answer is "**Calf**" [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Let's look at the meaning of given words. • **Foal**: a young horse or related animal. • **Lamb**: a young sheep. • **Cub:** the young of a fox, bear, lion, or other carnivorous mammals. • **Calf**: a young bovine animal, especially a domestic cow or bull in its first year. • As per the meaning of the given words, "**calf**" is the one-word substitute for the given group of words. • **Example**: *He recently sold his old cow and bought a **calf**.* Hence, the correct answer is** option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** • Let's look at the meaning of given words. • **Foal**: एक युवा घोड़ा या संबंधित जानवर। • **Lamb**: एक युवा भेड़। • **Cub:** एक लोमड़ी, भालू, शेर, या अन्य मांसाहारी स्तनधारियों के युवा। • **Calf**:एक युवा गोजातीय जानवर, विशेष रूप से अपने पहले वर्ष में एक घरेलू गाय या बैल। • As per the meaning of the given words, "**calf**" is the one-word substitute for the given group of words. 34:Tad3, The correct answer is "**He is being stared at by his mother.**"
